reviewDecisions.rationale: Official tariff reform plus coal-price intervention changes both sides of thermal-power unit economics; company-level normalized path can be tested.
Independent demand and physical input-price evidence create a real value-chain profit-pool question, with expectation duration explicitly at issue.
The explicit physical downturn is useful for testing whether the Skill correctly refuses stale-earnings bottom fishing or finds a genuinely differentiated path.
Policy tone is supportive but developer sales/cash/margin conversion is not established.
Broad stabilization is context rather than a narrow stock opportunity.
